title: iOS Export Crash
key_points: Godot Editor v4.7-beta1 crashes during export to iOS.
The crash occurs when exporting an app with the platform plugin enabled.
The issue is reproducible in Godot version 4.7-beta1.
limitations: The source provides system information but does not offer potential solutions or workarounds.
asserts: Godot Editor v4.7-beta1 crashes during the iOS export process when exporting an app with the platform plugin enabled.
scope: The scope of this assertion is limited to the specific instance of a crash that occurs during the iOS export process in Godot version 4.7-beta1.
